bundle.shortDescription: Mission control for governed AI coding-agent work
bundle.longDescription: Kranz is a local governance and evidence harness for headless AI coding agents. An orchestrator plans contract-first, fresh-context workers implement one feature at a time, independent validators judge each milestone, and you steer as project manager. This is the desktop Mission Control dashboard.
